mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA CII USING (
SELECT '${item.valId}' VAL_ID, '${item.prodId}' PROD_ID, '${item.assetId}' ASSET_ID, #{item.valueDate,jdbcType=DATE}null VALUE_DATE, #{item.mdate,jdbcType=DATE}null MDATE, ${item.posAmt}null POS_AMT, ${item.tdyCostAmt}null TDY_COST_AMT, ${item.tdyFloatIngpl}null TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, ${item.tdyIntincexp}null TDY_INTINCEXP, ${item.delayPayAmt}null DELAY_PAY_AMT, '${item.remark}' REMARK, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.dataSource}' DATA_SOURCE, '${item.md5primarykey}' MD5PRIMARYKEY FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID AND CII.ASSET_ID = TEMP.ASSET_ID AND CII.VALUE_DATE = TEMP.VALUE_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.VAL_ID = TEMP.VAL_ID, CII.MDATE = TEMP.MDATE, CII.POS_AMT = TEMP.POS_AMT, CII.TDY_COST_AMT = TEMP.TDY_COST_AMT, CII.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL = TEMP.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, CII.TDY_INTINCEXP = TEMP.TDY_INTINCEXP, CII.DELAY_PAY_AMT = TEMP.DELAY_PAY_AMT, CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE = TEMP.DEPT_CODE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.DATA_SOURCE = TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, CII.MD5PRIMARYKEY = TEMP.MD5PRIMARYKEY
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (VAL_ID, PROD_ID, ASSET_ID, VALUE_DATE, MDATE, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, STATUS, DATA_SOURCE,MD5PrimaryKey) VALUES( TEMP.VAL_ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.ASSET_ID, TEMP.VALUE_DATE, TEMP.MDATE, TEMP.POS_AMT, TEMP.TDY_COST_AMT, TEMP.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TEMP.TDY_INTINCEXP, TEMP.DELAY_PAY_AMT, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.MD5PRIMARYKEY)
